episodes.title: PATRA PARICHAY !
episodes.summary: Upon arriving in Bihar, police officer Amit Lodha grapples with a tough new way of life — but when a child is kidnapped, he springs into action.

episodes.title: CHANDANWA KA JANM !
episodes.summary: Chandan Mahto's notoriety grows after a bold move. As Amit's career advances, deep-rooted social mindsets and political pressures create hurdles.

episodes.title: AMIT KAUN ???
episodes.summary: In the lead-up to state elections, violence breaks out. Amit stands up to political power but receives backlash. Chandan makes a new adversary.

episodes.title: MOOH DIKHAI !!!
episodes.summary: After a bloody massacre orchestrated by Chandan, Amit is tasked with capturing the criminal — and faces a vexing road ahead.

episodes.title: MEETA JI KI LOVE STORY !!!
episodes.summary: Chandan's elusive whereabouts spark a new plan, with Amit and Ranjan using phone calls to track him. A secret tryst offers crucial clues.

episodes.title: MEETA JI KI LOVE STORY PART 2
episodes.summary: Amit makes a major announcement at a press meet. Chandan sets a trap with deadly consequences, while an explosive revelation stuns the team.

episodes.title: PHACE TO PHACE !
episodes.summary: The chase approaches a dramatic end, but peril lurks at every corner. The question remains: can Amit close the case, or will Chandan slip away?
